audience.programmeDescription: Earth, Climate and Technology at TU Delft combines Earth and climate science with mathematics, physics, chemistry, geodata and engineering applications. Fieldwork, a minor, design work and an individual research project connect this knowledge to practical challenges.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The external components and credits are shown. Fieldwork preparation and the ordinary sensing-to-fieldwork sequence have been checked. Entry conditions for the redesigned third-year design project, elective and final research project still need verification, so a full UCR comparison is withheld.

componentNotes.ect-minor: 30 EC of eligible non-overlapping minor study; positive BSA and any minor entry requirements apply. An outside-LDE, self-composed or foreign minor requires prior approval under the current rules.
componentNotes.ect-thesis: Required individual 15-EC research project, written report and presentation. Applicable course-entry conditions remain unverified.
componentNotes.ect-elective: 5-EC programme elective space. The current offer and applicable selection/entry conditions remain unverified.
componentNotes.ECTB1250: Required 4-EC field course. Expected preparation includes first-semester Earth and Climate System and Exploring the Grand Challenges, and participation in Surface, Water and Atmosphere and Geodata Fundamentals.
componentNotes.ECTB2250: Required 10-EC field project. Prerequisites include Earth and Climate System, Surface, Water and Atmosphere, Earth’s Subsurface, and Sensing and Spatial Analysis. The first sensing exam precedes field-project preparation and fieldwork; this sequence assumes successful first-sit completion.
